From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VeloHealth MAP initiation — weekly sync cadence & owners

Hi Sarah / team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a Mutual Action Plan (attached) to formalize the evaluation timeline and the close criteria so we have a single source of truth. I propose we run a short weekly checkpoint (30 minutes) to keep momentum and unblock decisions.

Proposed cadence:
- Weekly, Tuesdays at 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — sync + blockers
- Ad-hoc deep dives as needed for eval or infra work

Immediate success criteria (draft):
1) Evaluation harness integrated with VeloHealth test data and passing smoke tests (owner: marissa_cole) — target: 2 weeks
2) Latency & cost baseline collected across 3 pilot flows (owner: monica_patel) — target: 3 weeks
3) Security & data handling checklist complete and SOC2 evidence shared (owner: markus_klein) — target: 2 weeks
4) Commercial SOW agreed and signature-ready (owners: neha_kapoor / velo procurement) — target: 4 weeks

Action items I’ve already captured in the attached spreadsheet (Velo_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please review the owners above and flag any changes. If the cadence/time works, I’ll send a calendar invite and kick off the first checkpoint next Tuesday.

Attachments: Velo_MAP_v1.xlsx, Velo_Initial_Eval_Set.md

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
